summary: @servicetitan/hammer-icon preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: This package advertises itself as an SVG icon library (mdi/*.svg) but its package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 for the current platform from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a ~727KB CommonJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with a rotated string-array (`WV8StW` shuffler, `hc1jfK9` decoder, randomized identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`), so its behavior cannot be read statically. The alternate-runtime invocation is used specifically because Node-based install-time scanners will not evaluate a Bun-only bundle. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is declared in the package.json `files` allowlist (`mdi/{filled,outlined,round,sharp,two-tone}/*.svg`, `CHANGELOG.md`), indicating these components were included outside the author's normal publish path. An obfuscated Bun-only payload executed automatically on `npm install` is inconsistent with an icon library and is the shape of a dropper against installer machines under the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
